title: Zesty Pungent Middle Eastern Ackee Labneh
description: A pungent and glassy-jelly Middle Eastern dish featuring ackee and confit-tomato, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.

ingredients.name: ackee
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the labneh cheese with lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the chopped ackee to the labneh mixture and stir well.
Spread the confit tomato on top of the labneh mixture.
Drizzle the olive oil over the confit tomato.
Toast the pita bread and chop it into small pieces.
Sprinkle the toasted pita bread over the top of the dish.
Bake the dish in the oven for 15 minutes or until the pita bread is crispy.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Zesty Pungent Middle Eastern Ackee Labneh warm or at room temperature.
